# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version of `laravel-queue-watch` receives security updates.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Latest | :white_check_mark: |
| Older majors | :x: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please email **harrison.ratcliffe@me.com** instead of opening a public issue.

Please include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Steps to reproduce it, or a proof of concept.
- Any relevant PHP/Laravel version details.

You should expect an initial response within a few days. Once a fix is confirmed, a patch release will be published and the issue disclosed responsibly.
